thresholdObservations.description: Set the normalized Z score threshold for the anomalies generated.
thresholdObservations.name: ScoreThreshold

properties.description: This algorithm finds anomalous process paths in Windows systems using a word2vec language model. It analyzes SecurityEvents/4688 events to create a vocabulary of process paths in the workspace over 21 days. Based on this vocabulary, it builds a probability distribution of paths for each process in the workspace and then determines outliers using a z-score on each day.
properties.displayName: Anomalous Process Path used by a user account
